clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 application client ID issued by the vendor's developer portal

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: OAuth2 application client secret issued by the vendor's developer portal

authorizationUrl.title: Authorization URL
authorizationUrl.description: OAuth2 authorization endpoint the user is redirected to for consent (user-facing leg of the Authorization Code grant)

tokenUrl.title: Token URL
tokenUrl.description: OAuth2 token endpoint used to exchange the authorization code (and later, refresh tokens) for an access token

redirectUri.title: Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Registered OAuth2 redirect (callback) URI the vendor sends the authorization code to

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: Current OAuth2 access token (short-lived; refreshed automatically via refreshToken)

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token used to mint a new access token when the current one expires. Some vendors ROTATE the refresh token on every use (the token returned by a refresh call is single-use and replaces the prior one) -- when supportsRotatingRefreshToken is true, the connector MUST persist the newest refresh token returned by every token-exchange call, not just the initial one, or subsequent refreshes will fail.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: OAuth2 scopes requested at authorization time (space-separated)

supportsRotatingRefreshToken.title: Rotating Refresh Token
supportsRotatingRefreshToken.description: True when the vendor issues a NEW single-use refresh token on every refresh call (the connector must overwrite refreshToken with the newest value after each exchange). False when the vendor issues a long-lived refresh token that stays valid across many refreshes.
